name: William M. Brewer
role: Former Minnesela Boomer editor; helped issue the Cow Boy
bio: William M. "Billy" Brewer, late editor of the Minnesela Boomer, came to Medora from Deadwood in June 1884 and helped issue the Cow Boy while the editor was away that July. He also branded calves at Wadsworth's ranch before leaving for home in Deadwood later that month.

moments.label: Helped issue the Cow Boy during the editor's absence
